text: 深成指跌超1%，沪指跌0.44%，创业板指跌0.91%，贵金属、房地产、白酒、旅游等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近3500只
text_en: Shenzhen Component falls over 1%, Shanghai Composite down 0.44%, ChiNext Index down 0.91%; precious metals, real estate, baijiu, tourism among the biggest decliners; nearly 3,500 stocks fall across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
